summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Tutorial on Creating Home Goods Welcome to Marvelous Designer's tutorial video on home appliances. In this tutorial, you will learn some preparations we need to make before creating home appliances. ## Importing 3D Objects It will be more convenient to import 3D objects separately before creating home appliances. Let's import the bed part first as a virtual model. Then, import the rest of the objects one by one. ### Adjusting Object Size Make sure to increase the size of the bed part. After importing all the objects, save the whole thing. This will become a project file. You can download all the OBJ files from the link in the description below this video. ### Position Adjustment When you import these objects separately, you can adjust their position independently. After selecting an object, you can use the location tool to adjust its position. These bed parts are used as a whole OBJ, so they are also grouped together when adjusting the position. ### Managing Visibility Since the objects are imported as virtual models, they can be hidden or deleted as needed. If you hide an object, you can right-click in the 3D window and select "Show All Objects." You can also hide objects in the 3D window and later choose to show them again. ## Using the Stock Grid In the production of home appliances, you will often use the 2014 Stock Grid button. These operations are also performed via the DC fee tip you submitted. ### Finalizing the Model After editing the virtual model, you can utilize the true-file output function. Once you have adjusted the virtual model, you can use the cancel and touch fixes function. ### Surface Diameter Adjustment Due to the adaptability of the model, it is inserted into the model, which may cause a conflict with the fabric. Each object has a default surface diameter of 3 mm. You can reduce this attribute according to your needs, making the fabric more suitable for the object, and vice versa. ```
